pages.description: Come with us on a journey 625 meters above the sea, among tree tops and in a landscape that’s just as gorgeous in summer as it is in winter.

Welcome to Fýri Resort | Hotel and Conference in Hemsedal, Norway
Skip to content
Fyri Startsida
Fýri Resort Hotel and Conference in Hemsedal, Norway
Where the mountains are yours
Fýri Resort is your boutique mountain stay in the Norwegian mountains of Hemsedal, where the seasons are dramatic and the pace is entirely your own.
Award-Winning
Boutique Resort
In the mountains of Hemsedal
Fýri Resort is a mountain resort in Hemsedal, Norway, offering hotel stays, dining, spa experiences, activities and events in the heart of the Norwegian mountains.
Like the Alps, only Scandinavian
There s more to Fýri than the mountain. 145 rooms, a thousand-square-meter Pool Club , restaurants , bars, and games. And once the day is done, the evenings turn into just one more by the fire, where an hour slips by and the people around you start to feel like old friends.
Book your stay
GET OUT & EXPLORE
Adventure outside
your door
ACTIVITIES AT FÝRI RESORT
Pool Club
35°C water, cold drinks, and mountains in every direction. It s the pool club nobody expects this high up, and the one no one wants to climb out of. Turns out you don t need a coastline for any of this.
Explore The Pool Club
Only at Fýri Resort
There are experiences here you won t get anywhere else. Come see what we mean.
Norway s Best Conference Hotel
A conference at Fýri is more than just another meeting. It s a chance to get the team out of the office and into the mountains, where crisp air and a change of scene do wonders for focus.
Meetings & Conferences
Weddings in the mountains
Say yes high in the mountains, with the whole day taken care of. We ll handle everything from the ceremony to the last dance so you can stay fully in the moment.
Plan your wedding at Fýri
Themed Trips & Events
There s always something happening at Fýri, from active weekends to celebrations worth travelling for. Take a look at what s coming up.
Upcoming Events
NO NEED TO RUSH
Stay a little longer
Explore Packages
Restaurants
Some of the best hours at Fýri are spent around the table. Between the restaurants and bars there s a place for every mood, from a quick drink to a proper dinner at Restaurant Liv. The menu follows the season, so there s always a reason to come back.
Explore The Restaurants
Don t just take our word for it
“This was quite an experience. Beautiful and clean. Loved the bars and fire places. Great breakfast. Can’t say enough about this hotel. Amazing and can’t beat the views!”
Joseph , review from Expedia
“Amazing. We do love every little thing about this resort. We have been here several times and definitely coming back again and again!”
Artator , review from TripAdvisor
A room to come back to
However you ve spent the day, the door closes and it s just you, the quiet, and the mountains through the window. Pick the one that fits, we ll have it warm and waiting.

Fýri Resort, in the mountains of Hemsedal
How do I get to Fýri?
How do I get to Fýri?
The nearest airport is Oslo Gardermoen, around a three-hour drive away. Trains and buses also run from Oslo to Gol, a 25-minute drive from Fýri, with a direct bus from Oslo to Hemsedal via Gol.
Is Fýri open all year round?
Is Fýri open all year round?
Fýri is open through both the summer and winter seasons, with skiing in winter and hiking, biking, and more in summer. The Pool Club and restaurants are open in both seasons.
Are dogs allowed at Fýri?
Are dogs allowed at Fýri?
Yes, in a selection of dog-friendly rooms, for an extra 400 NOK per night. Dogs are welcome in most areas, though not in Restaurant Liv.
Is Fýri good for families?
Is Fýri good for families?
Yes. We have family rooms and suites that sleep up to six, and children are welcome across the resort, including at the Pool Club during family hours in the morning.
What s included in my stay at Fýri?
What s included in my stay at Fýri?
Every stay includes your room and breakfast. Some packages also include Pool Club access, dining, or activities, so it s worth checking what s listed under your chosen package.
What does it cost to stay at Fýri?
What does it cost to stay at Fýri?
Room rates vary by season and room type. You ll find current prices and packages when you book, with overnight stays including breakfast.
Fýri is Scandinavia s mountain boutique resort, high up in Hemsedal, Norway, just a few hours from Oslo. Ski-in, ski-out in winter, the slopes right outside the door, and trails from that same door in summer. And the rest of the time, a hotel built to keep you happily inside its walls.
There are 145 rooms , four restaurants and bars, and a thousand-square-meter Pool Club with 35°C water, indoor and outdoor pools, and a sauna. Dine on Mediterranean plates at Restaurant Liv, wood-fired pizza at Bar Liv, or alpine fondue at Rambler, then settle in by the fire at ROA. Outside, the mountains hold skiing, hiking, biking, padel, and dog sledding, whatever the season.
Fýri is also one of Norway s most awarded conference hotels , with rooms for groups from two to 350. Come for a weekend, a wedding, or a week of meetings, there s a stay to suit.
This is mountain living, with resort life built in. Where the mountains are yours.

Rooms & Suites at Fýri Hemsedal | Fýri Resort
Skip to content
Our Rooms
Hotel Rooms & Suites at Fýri Resort Hemsedal
Rooms with a View
Every room at Fýri is designed for the mountains – natural materials, muted tones, and large windows that let the light in. You sleep well, wake up to breakfast, and step straight out to the ski lift. Choose from a range of rooms and suites, from bright doubles to spacious suites with room for the whole family.
Find your room
All our rooms share the same calm and quality – what changes is the size and the view. Some face the mountains, others give you extra room for family or friends. Whichever you choose, breakfast, gym access, and your own ski locker are included.
Standard Double
A calm double room with everything you need after a day outside. King size bed, private bathroom with shower, and plenty of space to settle in.
King size bed

Frequently asked Questions about our rooms
Can I ski straight from my room to the slopes?
Can I ski straight from my room to the slopes?
Yes. Fýri is ski-in, ski-out, with our own lift taking you directly from the hotel to the ski area. Later in the season, the Centrum Run lets you ski all the way back to Fýri.
Do you have dog-friendly rooms?
Do you have dog-friendly rooms?
Yes. We have a selection of dog-friendly rooms for an additional NOK 400 per night.
Can I book a room with a mountain view?
Can I book a room with a mountain view?
Yes. The Standard Double Mountain View faces the peaks, so you can watch the weather move across the mountains from bed. It has the same comfort as our Standard Double: a king size bed, 20 m², and room for two.
What s the difference between a Standard Double and a Superior Double?
What s the difference between a Standard Double and a Superior Double?
Both have a king size bed and sleep two. The Superior Double is larger, at 25–27 m² compared with 20 m², and adds armchairs and extra wardrobe space. That makes it a good choice if you re staying a few nights longer.
What s included when I stay in a room at Fýri?
What s included when I stay in a room at Fýri?
Every room includes breakfast, gym access, and your own private ski locker, which you open with your room key (one locker per room). Pool Club access, dining, and activities are included in some packages. Check what s listed under your package when you book.
What s included when I stay in a room at Fýri?
What s included when I stay in a room at Fýri?
Every room includes breakfast, gym access, and your own private ski locker, which you open with your room key (one locker per room). Pool Club access, dining, and activities are included in some packages. Check what s listed under your package when you book.
Which rooms at Fýri are best for families?
Which rooms at Fýri are best for families?
The Suite (56 m²) sleeps up to four, with a king size bed in one bedroom, bunk beds in a second bedroom, and a shared living area. For larger families or groups of friends, the Executive Suite (95 m²) sleeps up to eight across two bedrooms, with a private kitchen, fireplace, balcony, and garage space.
